hook: Why Xi met Trump at the airport
reel_hook: Xi did something extremely rare today

slides.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to meet
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round table with three small flags on stands, in a grand hall with soft morning light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Xi greeted Trump at Shenzhen airport with a hug.
WHY IT MATTERS
On Thursday, they meet Putin for first-ever three-way talks.
FOR YOU
Expect few concrete results, but watch for signals on Iran and Ukraine.
slides.body: Xi greeted Trump at Shenzhen airport with a hug. On Thursday, they meet Putin for first-ever three-way talks. Expect few concrete results, but watch for signals on Iran and Ukraine.

slides.title: US and Iran trade strikes
slides.image_prompt: A narrow sea strait at dusk with an oil tanker, distant missile launch site on a rocky island, faint smoke trail in the sky
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran sent drones at a US base in Bahrain; US jets hit back.
WHY IT MATTERS
Third Iranian attack in five days, by a key oil route.
FOR YOU
No damage reported so far; Qatar is still mediating talks with Iran.
slides.body: Iran sent drones at a US base in Bahrain; US jets hit back. Third Iranian attack in five days, by a key oil route. No damage reported so far; Qatar is still mediating talks with Iran.

slides.title: Nvidia: Huang won't return
slides.image_prompt: An empty leather executive chair beside a glowing green computer chip on a desk, a rising bar chart made of stacked chips behind it
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Nvidia's board says ex-CEO Jensen Huang won't be reinstated.
WHY IT MATTERS
Quarterly revenue still more than doubled: $115.8 billion.
FOR YOU
Colette Kress stays interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent one.
slides.body: Nvidia's board says ex-CEO Jensen Huang won't be reinstated. Quarterly revenue still more than doubled: $115.8 billion. Colette Kress stays interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent one.

slides.title: Peltola wins Alaska Senate
slides.image_prompt: A ballot box in front of snowy Alaskan mountains under a pale sky, with a wooden Senate-style gavel resting on top
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Democrat Mary Peltola beat Republican Senator Dan Sullivan.
WHY IT MATTERS
Democrats will hold 56 of 100 Senate seats from January.
FOR YOU
From January, a 56-seat Democratic majority shapes which bills and nominees advance.
slides.body: Democrat Mary Peltola beat Republican Senator Dan Sullivan. Democrats will hold 56 of 100 Senate seats from January. From January, a 56-seat Democratic majority shapes which bills and nominees advance.

slides.title: Chatbots gave out attack plans
slides.image_prompt: A thick blank government report on a dark desk beside four glowing speech-bubble shapes made of light, a red warning lamp glowing in the background
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
US auditors got four big chatbots to write attack plans.
WHY IT MATTERS
A Senate committee now plans hearings on AI safety.
FOR YOU
Hearings on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok could shape your chatbot's safeguards.
